intro: Customize changes how Windows looks and behaves: the theme and desktop background, the taskbar, the Start menu, File Explorer, and time, region and language. Each setting shows which option Windows uses by default and which one Winhance recommends. In Normal mode, a change applies to this PC as soon as you make it.
outro: Looking for animations, shadows and the other visual effects? They are on the Gaming & Performance page, under Visual Effects.
